notes.title: NEW SYMBOLS in Update #2 and special announcement for Cheaters!
notes.content:
Leaderboards now properly supporting Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai and Arabic symbols. Now your steam account should be named correctly in leaderboards.

All cheaters caught using CheatEngine or Artmoney to manipulate scores will be granted an amnesty! Now you're eligible to contribute to BUG EXTERMINATION again!

Friendly reminder - Autoclickers are okay; trying to instantly get a huge score is not okay.

Just have fun and SMASH bugs. You don't need to prove anything to anyone because we love you anyway! ♥♥♥

Thank you!

notes.title: Twitch Integration Is Here!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there, Twitch users![/h2]

Nice news for you: we're happy to announce that BUG is supporting Twitch integration. Check out our official 24-hour stream to try it out! Join the chat and write [b]!shoot[/b] or [b]!join [/b]to see how it works.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/dmitrybeley]Official stream on Twitch[/url]

Send BUG to the streamer you love the most. We're thrilled to see how this game will work with huge chats.

[h2]How it works:[/h2]

You just visit the leaderboard and press the T button — Twitch connects to BUG, some magic happens, and your viewers can write commands in the chat to control the game:

[list]
[*] !shoot - to kill the bug with the second gun
[*] !join - to name a certain bug with your name
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036470/6e4248a6ba18abcead06135077736a3e60c1d1a6.png[/img]

[h2]Have fun with it![/h2]

notes.title: WISHLIST DRAKE ⬇ ⬇ ⬇
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735880/DRAKE/

Drake is a deep and complex game that we've been making for six years. It is a game about space cowboys and outlaws trying to survive on a distant desert planet called Drake. BUG is a part of that game.

BUG is one of the local fauna living in numerous caves on Drake, causing many problems for the miners and other colonists. Some developers from Kayden City created an arcade game where you need to smash as many bugs as you can.

BUG brings that to you. But if you want to experience the full spectrum of emotions, check out Drake!

Thanks!
